title: Assemble thermodynamic database
action: Using PyCalphad, define the pure element references (SGTE) and construct the phase models for fcc, liquid, ζ, ζ', δ, and the five stoichiometric compounds, inserting all optimized parameters given in the instruction. Create a working thermodynamic database object ready for equilibrium calculations.
description: Build the complete Ni-In thermodynamic description as a PyCalphad database object.

title: Compute invariant equilibria
action: Compute the full T-x phase diagram of the Ni-In system at 1 bar and extract the list of invariant reactions: reaction type, temperature (°C), and compositions (at% In) of the participating phases.
description: CSV file listing all invariant equilibria from the phase diagram calculation, as given in the paper (Table 6).
output_schema: Columns: reaction (string), T_C (float), composition_phase1 (float, at% In), composition_phase2 (float, at% In), composition_phase3 (float, at% In). Each row corresponds to one invariant reaction.

title: Compute In partial pressures
action: For the four two-phase regions (ζ/ζ', ζ'/NiIn, NiIn/Ni₂In₃, Ni₂In₃/liquid), calculate the equilibrium partial pressure of In at 1000 K.
description: CSV file with log10 of In partial pressure (in bar) for each two-phase region at 1000 K.
output_schema: Columns: two_phase_region (string), log_p_In (float). Rows: ζ/ζ', ζ'/NiIn, NiIn/Ni₂In₃, Ni₂In₃/liquid.

title: Compute enthalpies of melting
action: Determine the congruent melting points and enthalpies of fusion for the ζ-Ni₂In and δ-NiIn phases.
description: CSV file with melting temperature, composition, and enthalpy of melting for the two congruently melting intermetallic compounds.
output_schema: Columns: phase (string), melting_T_C (float), composition (float, atomic fraction In), enthalpy_melting (float, J/mol). Rows for ζ-Ni₂In and δ-NiIn.
